scopeLimits: Only DELETE /v1/support-access/staff/:id changes. The existing ORM SELECT FOR UPDATE remains exact; a new statement checks MFA after its possible wait and before missing/inactive outcomes. UPDATE consumes a materialized guard; final MFA covers staff audit and automatic grant revocations transactionally.

The shared revokeGrant helper, POST staff, POST/DELETE grants, schemas, policies and migrations remain unchanged. This is whole-transaction protection for automatic revocations, not a claim that every internal grant statement is individually guarded.

Direct cases enroll flag/global-binding administrators through real HTTP/TOTP in the same family. Staff/grant history is explicit SQL fixture data. No positive factor/proof is fabricated in these35 cases.
Baseline has fifteen204 and four404 versus403. Successful active/inactive outcomes verify exact bindings, grants, audit and same-token access; missing paths verify unchanged data.

Twelve interleavings follow actual parameterized rbac:manage authorization. Four further cases use a real owner row lock; Each polling iteration clears only its current-transaction statistics snapshot; pg_blocking_pids observes exactly one actual restricted app connection blocked on role_bindings before factor/proof withdrawal is committed with lock release. Active/inactive staff and a flag administrator are covered; other lock/authority combinations remain pending.

Eight positive combinations cover flag/global-binding authorities and active/inactive/expired/duplicate staff. Identity and untouched bindings/grant history remain exact; open including expired grants close and receive one audit each. Previously revoked grants stay unchanged.

Legacy inactive-binding204 returns without closing preexisting open grants or auditing; it still denies target telemetry. This contract is preserved, not claimed as repaired cleanup of historical inconsistent data. Repeated active removal produces no new audit.

Three proof-removing triggers on role_bindings/support_grants UPDATE and staff audit INSERT fire once. Rollback restores exact target account, bindings, all grants, audit and original family proof timestamp text/generation/presence.

Three narrow generic trigger exceptions preserve rows/proof with opaque500; a BEFORE UPDATE skip retains the audit policy403 and closes no grants. Missing/invalid/wrong-role/unauthenticated/local/resident refusals and absence of password-recency requirement are covered.

Five regression files give68 TAP:64 independent cases and4 aggregate groups, including the36 staff creation tests. Historical read fixtures retain direct-SQL proof limitations. Guards remain1536MiB; historical runs are not added to corrected counts.

rbac:manage without support:grant, grants commands, configurations, other domains/promotions/concurrency, legacy cache, integrated API/browser/native Android/iOS, performance and production acceptance remain pending.
